description: This file defines the MultiTrustManager class, which implements a custom X509TrustManager for handling SSL certificate trust validation by managing multiple keystores.

classes.name: MultiTrustManager
classes.description: A custom implementation of X509TrustManager that manages multiple KeyStores for SSL certificate trust validation, allowing addition of keystores dynamically and verifying client and server certificates against stored certificates.

methods.name: MultiTrustManager
methods.description: Constructor initializing with a default list of keystores.

methods.name: MultiTrustManager
methods.description: Constructor initializing with a specific keystore.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a KeyStore to the internal list for trust validation.

methods.name: getNumberOfKeyStores
methods.description: Returns the number of keystores managed by this trust manager.

methods.name: checkClientTrusted
methods.description: Verifies if the client certificates are trusted based on stored keystores and properties.

methods.name: checkServerTrusted
methods.description: Verifies if the server certificates are trusted based on stored keystores and properties.

methods.name: getAcceptedIssuers
methods.description: Returns all accepted issuer certificates from all managed keystores.

methods.name: isTrusted
methods.description: Helper method to determine if given certificates are trusted by this trust manager.
